title: Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Membership Fee and Trial Schedule
content:
Every tier of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** lives on the customer's one rewards membership. The three Pals Rewards tiers carry no membership fee; the three Tailwise Plus tiers are paid tiers billed on a fixed cycle. This schedule states, tier by tier, the fee per billing period, the billing cycle, whether the paid term renews automatically, and the free-trial terms.

## Fee and trial table

| Tier | Fee per billing period | Billing cycle | Renews automatically unless cancelled | Free trial before the first fee | Trial look-back (no membership fee charged in this many calendar days before enrollment) | Payment card on file needed for a trial | Unused part of the current fee credited on a move to a higher paid tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | $0.00 | none | No | 0 days | 0 days | No | No |
| Pals Rewards Insider | $0.00 | none | No | 0 days | 0 days | No | No |
| Pals Rewards VIP | $0.00 | none | No | 0 days | 0 days | No | No |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | $5.99 | monthly | Yes | 30 days | 365 days | Yes | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | $59.00 | annual | Yes | 30 days | 365 days | Yes | Yes |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | $119.00 | annual | Yes | 0 days | 0 days | No | No |

## Notes on the schedule

- The fee is charged once per billing period: every month for Tailwise Plus Monthly, once a year for Tailwise Plus Annual and Tailwise Plus Premier Annual. A tier whose billing cycle is "none" has no billing period and no fee.
- A free trial is offered only by Tailwise Plus Monthly and Tailwise Plus Annual: 30 free days, for a customer with no membership fee charged in the 365 calendar days before enrollment, and only with a payment card on file. Tailwise Plus Premier Annual offers no free trial.
- The credit of the unused part of the current fee on a move to a higher paid tier is marked "Yes" for Tailwise Plus Monthly and Tailwise Plus Annual and "No" for Tailwise Plus Premier Annual and the free tiers.

## Reading the table

**Which tiers renew on their own?** All three Tailwise Plus tiers renew automatically unless cancelled; the free tiers have nothing to renew.

**What does a year of Tailwise Plus Monthly cost at the listed fee?** As a hypothetical illustration only, twelve monthly fees of $5.99 total $71.88, against $59.00 for one annual fee of Tailwise Plus Annual.
